result.rationale: The migration builds the INSERT via string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"` where `h` comes from legacy site-setting values split by newline with no quoting/sanitization. An apostrophe in a legacy host value would break out of the string literal and inject SQL, and even a benign apostrophe crashes the migration. Mechanism is verifiable directly in the diff.
